races.display_title: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: Time has already shown SEA LANTERN faced a really stiff task conceding chunks of weight to a pair of upwardly-mobile 3-y-os in a 1¼m novice here back in the spring. That was his best effort yet and with the return to further a plus on handicap debut, Brian Ellison's charge looks to have plenty going for him returning from a break. Traveling Man and Morbeh can offer up chief resistance, in that order. SEA LANTERN TRAVELING MAN MORBEH

races.display_title: Matty Bown Handicap
races.verdict: William Haggas' 3-y-o VENETIAN LION hasn't looked back since going handicapping and gets a confident vote to complete the hat-trick off a still very workable-looking mark. races.verdict: DIGGER ONE is very much a late developer and looked one to keep firmly onside when following up his breakthrough Salisbury victory at Kempton 2 weeks ago, coming from near-last to first in under a furlong for no more than hands-and-heels riding. A 6 lb rise shouldn't prevent him making a bold bid to complete a quick-fire hat-trick, with An Bradan Feasa and No More Bolero fancied to pose the chief threats. DIGGER ONE AN BRADAN FEASA (IRE) NO MORE BOLERO

races.verdict: Preference is for TIMELY AFFAIR , who made it back-to-back wins when scoring at Lingfield last month and he can add to his tally in his current form. Eduardo Calderon conceded first run when second at Epsom recently and is feared most with more still to offer over this trip, ahead of Dashing Dick . TIMELY AFFAIR EDUARDO CALDERON (IRE) DASHING DICK (IRE)

races.verdict: WOPBOPALOOMOP transformed when winning a competitive 14-runner nursery at Windsor 10 days ago after a 4-month break, proving strong at the finish over this trip, and she can defy her penalty if this doesn't come too soon. Secret Rival went with more zest at Newcastle last time and shaped as if back in form, so is feared most, while Crowned has form to make an impact but his stable have been quiet of late. WOPBOPALOOMOP SECRET RIVAL (IRE) CROWNED (IRE)

races.verdict: ORIENTAL PRINCE gets the vote, with the form of his recent York win starting to work out well. Hat-trick-seeking Startling is next best, while Knicks could prove himself well treated if things fall right. Never Dark makes each-way appeal and completes the shortlist for this ultra-competitive sprint. ORIENTAL PRINCE STARTLING KNICKS (IRE)

races.verdict: ICE CUBE took a while to hit full stride when finishing fourth at Epsom on his latest outing 5 weeks ago, yet he'd looked one to keep on side in this sort of company when scoring at that venue previously and could well be worth chancing to resume progress for a stable enjoying a highly-productive season. races.display_title: Tennent's Lager Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: This looks wide open and with that in mind it could pay to take a chance on MINSTREL KNIGHT . He's been absent since shaping as if amiss at Thirsk back in the spring but with easier ground in his favour from what appeals as a handy mark, he may represent a spot of value with his yard enjoying a really productive season. Ashnak shaped better than the distance beaten suggests at Haydock last time and is next best ahead of Elsass . MINSTREL KNIGHT ASHNAK (FR) ELSASS (IRE)
